properties.displayName: [Baseline] Key vaults should have purge protection enabled
properties.description: Denies key vaults that do not enable purge protection. Purge protection prevents a soft-deleted vault or secret from being permanently purged before its retention period expires, which is the safeguard against a malicious or accidental insider destroying keys that encrypt production data. Vaults that omit the property are flagged because the platform default leaves purge protection off.

metadata.description: The effect the policy applies when a key vault lacks purge protection.
